audit.why: Reused from the mirror at audits/top/camille__jayce.json rather than re-derived: Jayce owns level 1 only, Camille owns 3 through first item, and the two-item stage is a skill window. The content prose here already says exactly that ('She out-scales you flat', 'you cannot win the straight 1v1 once she has two items'), so the stage ownership is settled and consistent in both directions.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why for level 6 is generic Jayce boilerplate ('six abilities against his four') and carries no number for The Hextech Ultimatum.
audit.why: R is 140/115/90s. That number is the whole reason a dodged cage is a two-minute reprieve, and it is the difference between hiding for ten seconds and playing the wave for a full minute.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why rewritten around the 140s figure and the wall constraint.

audit.whatIsWrong: Tactical Sweep (W) is described four times as a cone that 'heals her off you' with no mention of where. Riot's text is explicit: only enemies in the OUTER half are slowed, take extra damage, and heal her.
audit.why: This is the single most actionable thing in the matchup and it is nowhere on the page. Stepping toward Camille rather than away from her denies the slow, the bonus damage and the entire heal — which also removes the reason the page tells you to buy anti-heal.
audit.corrected: Stated in the Key Ability Interactions entry, dontsFull[1] and wants.you[0].
sources: audits/top/camille__jayce.json (mirror states the same outer-edge heal)

audit.whatIsWrong: Hookshot's wall requirement is hinted at once in the tldr ('don't fight near walls') but never stated as a rule, and breakdown.cooldowns describes it only as 'Her engage/stun'.
audit.why: Riot's E text is 'Camille pulls herself to a wall, leaping off'. With no wall in reach she has no gap-closer and no stun — that turns 'respect her engage' into a positioning instruction the player can actually follow.
audit.corrected: Stated in breakdown.cooldowns, the Key Ability Interactions entry and dosFull[0], with the 16s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Camille is called 'he'/'his' in fifteen full-layer fields, including the Itemization line ('his healing fights your pattern'), and dosFull[2] / dontsFull[1] carry descriptions copied from unrelated template lines.
audit.why: Wrong pronouns and mismatched title/description pairs read as unmaintained data.
audit.corrected: Pronouns corrected throughout; both descriptions rewritten with real mechanics.

edits.after: The Hextech Ultimatum cages you in a 1v1 for 140s at rank 1; your R is only the stance swap. Never fight it beside a wall.

edits.before: - Camille Hookshot: matchup-defining — Her engage/stun. E-knock/dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

notes: Adaptive Defenses (P) is worth a follow-up I did not have room to write into a field: Riot's text gives Camille a shield sized to a percentage of her max health AGAINST THE DAMAGE TYPE that hit her (Physical or Magic). Jayce is one of the few champions who deals both — Shock Blast, To the Skies! and his autos are physical, Thundering Blow and the Mercury Hammer first attack are magic. If the shield really is typed per-trigger, alternating stances mid-trade should blunt it, and that would be a strong Jayce-specific line. I could not confirm from the kit whether the shield re-evaluates its type on each proc or locks on the first, so I did not write it. Reused from the mirror audit rather than re-researched: the outer-half heal on Tactical Sweep, and the mirror's finding that the kit's untargetable/channel flags on R contradict Riot's own description (a dash plus an anchoring zone) and are tooltip-parse misfires — so I wrote nothing about dodging the R cast.
